I joined MyVet and signed up to their Pet Health Plan, which I later paid over €300 to get out of.

My dog had a skin condition and required treatment. We were prescribed antibiotics and a medicated shampoo, which cost close to €30 per bottle. I called ahead and ordered a few more bottles, as I was travelling from Shankill specifically to collect them.

When I arrived, I was told I could only have one bottle. I explained that I had travelled from Shankill and had specifically ordered multiple bottles in advance. The response I received was, “Well, what if someone else needs them?”

I later went to a vet in Lusk and was able to get a shampoo containing the ingredient my dog actually needed for around €10.

I contacted MyVet afterwards and asked to speak with a manager. I explained exactly what had happened and how I had been spoken to. Unfortunately, nothing appeared to be done about it.

The next time I attended, I dealt with the same receptionist and once again found her manner rude, short and extremely ignorant, this time in front of other staff members and customers.

That was the final straw for me. I called and cancelled my membership because, as I explained to the manager, I am not prepared to pay for a service and be spoken to like that, particularly when it had now happened on more than one occasion.

Very disappointing customer service and ultimately the reason I chose to leave.
